name: Hanoi to Mai Chau
summary: Take a bus, shuttle, or car on the road through Hoa Binh, about 140 km and two and a half to three hours. Leave in the morning to see the valley from Thung Khe pass on the way in.

modes.note: Buses leave Bến xe Mỹ Đình, and shuttles also run (Vietnam Tourism). Local buses stop in Mai Châu town, a short walk from Bản Lác and Pom Coọng. Vietnam Tourism prints about three hours on two pages and 2.5 hours on a third. Fares are Check on arrival.
About 140 km via Hòa Bình (Vietnam Tourism, Phú Thọ tourism). Thung Khe pass gives the first view of the valley. Vietnam Tourism suggests a morning drive for it.

seoTitle: Hanoi to Mai Chau — bus, shuttle, or car
seoDescription: Hanoi to Mai Chau is about 140 km by road via Hoa Binh: buses from My Dinh, shuttles, and the drive over Thung Khe pass.

faqs.q: Is there a train to Mai Chau?
faqs.a: No station is named for Mai Châu. Go by road.
Vietnam Tourism says the June–August monsoon can flood local roads. A closure on a given day is Check on arrival.

faqs.q: What about going back to Hanoi?
faqs.a: Use the same road east through Hòa Bình. Ask at your homestay for the current bus or shuttle. Check on arrival.
